messages.content:
You are Offramp's Adapter Agent. Offramp moves one LLM call site in a Python repo from a closed model (OpenAI or Anthropic SDK) to NVIDIA Nemotron on Nebius Token Factory, an OpenAI-compatible chat.completions API, and evaluates the migrated call before opening a pull request. The patched code sends exactly what the evaluation sends, and the code around the call does not change: the reply must stay parseable by it.

A deterministic translator has already mapped the call (spec_v0): Anthropic tools to OpenAI function tools, tool_choice, system= to a system message, max_tokens, response_format and temperature. You decide only what it cannot:

reasoning: "off", or "low"/"medium"/"high" for on (Token Factory has a single thinking switch, so the three levels behave the same). Nemotron thinks by default; Offramp always sends the switch explicitly and adds 2000 tokens of room when thinking is on. Thinking costs latency and output tokens. Turn it on when the task needs multi-step reasoning (arithmetic, policies with several rules, multi-constraint logic) or the source model is itself a reasoning model. Keep it off for classification, extraction, tool choice, summaries and short answers. On the Lightning tier, thinking leaks reasoning prose into the reply text.

output_mode: "text" keeps the call's own output format. "json_schema" constrains the reply to the site's JSON schema with server-side guided decoding. "json_object" asks for any JSON object and validates it against the schema afterwards, with one repair retry. Choose a JSON mode only when the calling code parses the reply as a JSON object; never for labels, free text or tool calls. Without a known output schema, json_schema falls back to json_object.

user_suffix: an optional instruction appended to the end of the user message to pin the exact output format the calling code parses, for example "Reply with the queue name only." Leave it empty when the prompt already pins the format unambiguously. Never change the task, add facts or contradict the system prompt.

notes: up to 5 short facts for the reviewer about this migration. risk_flags: up to 5 concrete ways Nemotron's behaviour could differ from the source model at this call site, each "short_id: explanation".

Reply with one JSON object only.

schema.description: The Adapter Agent's reply: only the choices the deterministic translation cannot make.
schema.title: AdapterDecision

message.content:
{
  "reasoning": "off",
  "output_mode": "text",
  "user_suffix": "",
  "notes": [
    "Agent must call exactly one tool per step; tool_choice=required enforces this.",
    "Source model is non-reasoning (claude-sonnet-4-5); reasoning off avoids latency and token cost.",
    "System prompt duplicated in spec_v0.system_prompt and params.system; translator already handles.",
    "Temperature set to 0 for deterministic tool selection.",
    "No JSON output expected; model returns a tool call directly."
  ],
  "risk_flags": [
    "tool_call_format: Nemotron may format function calls differently than Anthropic's native tool use, requiring parser adjustments.",
    "policy_enforcement: Nemotron might not strictly enforce the 200.00 refund cap or eligibility rules without explicit reasoning.",
    "single_tool_adherence: Model could attempt multiple tool calls in one response despite tool_choice=required.",
    "order_id_extraction: May hallucinate or miss order IDs from ticket_text if not explicitly formatted.",
    "escalation_judgment: Could misclassify edge cases (e.g., borderline abuse, implicit legal threats) vs. Claude's training."
  ]
}
